[/color][i][color=#ffe599]About my mod :3
[/color][/i]
[color=#fff2cc] Sakura's Cafe is a simple yet interesting mod that adds in stereotypical and traditional coffee shop items! I plan on expanding this mod to more items, possibly a custom location and a vendor![i]
[/i]
﻿
Currently, this mod offers:
﻿☞ 4 Milkshakes (Vanilla, Tropical Fruit, Berry, Chocolate)
﻿☞ 4 Teas (Citrus, Cranberry, Strawberry, Peppermint)
﻿☞ 3 Slushies (Blueberry, Cherry, Lime)
﻿☞ 2 Lattes (Cinnamon, Pumpkin Spice)
☞ Hot Chocolate
﻿☞ Croissant, Crossbuns, Muffins[/color]

[color=#b4a7d6]━━━━━━━━━▲━━━━━━━━━
[/color][i][color=#a4c2f4]What are the requirements to download this mod?[/color][/i]

[color=#d0e0e3]JsonAssets (JA) is required to be able to download this mod, or else the mod will break![/color]

﻿━━━━━━━━━▲━━━━━━━━━
[i][color=#b6d7a8]How do I add this mod to my game?[/color]
[/i]
[color=#d9ead3]It's simple! Just move the file named <[JA] Sakura's Cafe> into your mods folder! [/color]

﻿ [color=#b4a7d6]━━━━━━━━━▲━━━━━━━━━[/color]
